help.noCli: Install the APEXREST plugin for Claude Code or Codex, or run npm install -g apexrest. A custom runtime goes in the widget's apexrestCommand setting.
help.noProject: No project yet. APEXREST shows the project an agent last worked in, or pin one with the widget's projectPath setting.
help.updateRuntime: This APEXREST runtime has no machine-wide settings. Update the APEXREST plugin, or point apexrestCommand at a newer runtime.
tip.doctor: Check Node.js, Java and SQLcl in a terminal (apexrest doctor).
tip.localPreview: Render the application locally with the Universal Theme and SQLite data. No database needed.
tip.connectedPreview: Connected preview: data and PL/SQL from this environment's database; every request is rolled back.
tip.ship: Ask the agent to ship the current changes to %1 (plan, backup and DEV/QA/TEST checks apply).
tip.validate: Compile the sources with the Oracle APEXlang compiler. No database call.
tip.agent: Start the default coding agent in the project folder.
preview.noAssets: No preview running. The first preview downloads the Universal Theme assets.
decisions.about: Ranks catalog components with OpenAI Decisions before the agent writes a page. Only the request and public catalog descriptions are sent.
decisions.keyFound: %1 is set in this desktop session.
decisions.keyMissing: %1 is not set in this desktop session; the agent's own environment may still have it. Without a key, selection stays local.
catalog.offAbout: Off: catalog search, read and select return CATALOG_DISABLED and agents write without lookups.
sqlcl.cliAbout: SQLcl subprocess over the Oracle listener.
sqlcl.mcpAbout: Official SQLcl MCP server, restrict level %1.
sqlcl.ordsAbout: SQLcl over ORDS REST-Enabled SQL (HTTPS, no port 1521). Requires the CLI backend.
sqlcl.noReferences: None. Add one with apexrest connection add.
tokens.about: OpenAI Decisions tokens. Coding-agent tokens are in Omarchy's Agents panel.
